o.text:
From Proto-Turkic *yeŋgül, *yeŋi-k (“light”). Cognate with Tatar җиңел (ciñel),
Bashkir еңел (yiñil), etc.
Ultimately from Arabic زِبْل (zibl). The sense “police” is a semantic loan from Russian му́сор (músor), see it for more.

glosses: toman (a Persian money of account or gold coin issued until 1927)

o.text: Borrowed from Persian تومان (tumân), ultimately same as above.
From veril- (“to be given”) + -iş. The sense 'program' is a calque of Russian переда́ча (peredáča).
